summary: Jwt expiration buffer in seconds (default 2) evicts cached JWTs before they expire so backends never get expired tokens; raise it if latency between gateway and services causes 401 errors. Other settings cover status endpoint backend timeout and verify, resource client request timeout and proxy request timeout (504).
questions: Why do I get intermittent 401 errors from controller through gateway?
What is the JWT expiration buffer default?
How do I fix 401 unauthorized with high latency to services?
Where do I set the gateway request timeout?

answer_card.title: Intermittent 401s from backend services
answer_card.answer_md: Gateway caches a JWT per user and sends it to controller and EDA. If it expires in transit you get **401**. Raise **Jwt expiration buffer in seconds** (default **2**) under **Settings > Platform gateway > Edit platform gateway settings > Other settings** when latency between gateway and services is high.
